questions.q: How do honeybees stay warm in winter?
choices: They huddle together in a big ball
questions.fact: They huddle! Bees pack into a ball called a winter cluster and shiver their wing muscles to make heat, keeping the middle toasty even when it's freezing outside.

questions.q: What do honeybees eat during the winter?
questions.fact: Their saved honey! Bees spend all summer storing honey so the colony has food to eat when no flowers are blooming.

questions.q: What happens to the drone (boy) bees when fall comes?
choices: They go to sleep until spring
The worker bees push them out of the hive
questions.fact: They get pushed out! Drones don't gather food or help keep the hive warm, so the workers kick them out to save honey for winter.

questions.q: How long can a worker bee born in the fall live?
questions.fact: Several months! Summer worker bees live about 6 weeks, but special winter bees can live 4 to 6 months to carry the colony through to spring.
